inspiration: Alien ruleset groups units by movement class (Earthly, Native, Sea, Amphibious, Antigravity, Burrowing, Missile) in data/alien/units.ruleset. Build creatures by how they move (burrow, glide, swim) so silhouettes differ at a glance.
Organic alien units such as Biomass and Spitter (data/alien/units.ruleset:1151 and :1078) suggest a living-mass native unit and a ranged organic spitter. Recreate the idea as our own creatures.
Rex, Crusher and Turtle Defender (units.ruleset:830, :759, :899) are named as big-body, heavy and shell-defence types. Use the role of each as a brief, not the look.
Explosions are layered by size (LrgExpl.ogg and SmlExpl.ogg in data/stdsounds). A small hit and a large blast share one sound family with different weight.

Isometric sprites come from 3D models rendered at a fixed iso camera (data/graphics/Elefant-Cimpletoon-Renderers/IsoRender64x48.blend). A fixed-camera render pass gives consistent sprites from our own models.
Hex and iso tile sets (data/hex2t, data/isophex, data/trident) show three board grid choices. Pick one per zone type rather than mixing.

briefs.label: Shell-back defender
briefs.rule: Recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy.
briefs.why: A defender defined by its shell reads as slow and tough from far away.
briefs.keep: Low, wide silhouette; armoured dome; stationary stance when defending
briefs.change: Use a plated armadillo or bivalve form, not a turtle; spines on the rim; cool palette rather than green
briefs.ref: data/alien/units.ruleset:899 (Turtle Defender; name only, graphic not located in box)

briefs.label: Throat-sac spitter
briefs.rule: Recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy.
briefs.why: A visible wind-up before a ranged shot tells the player the attack is coming.
briefs.keep: Inflate-then-fire telegraph; ranged shot; small upright body
briefs.change: Deliver a spore pod or seed burst instead of acid; different body plan (no neck); a stalk root instead of legs
briefs.ref: data/alien/units.ruleset:1078 (Spitter; Heavy Spitter also in the class)

briefs.label: Front-loaded crusher
briefs.rule: Recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy.
briefs.why: A heavy front mass says 'avoid me' at a glance.
briefs.keep: Front-loaded mass; slow advance; a ram or plate on the front
briefs.change: Tracked or wheeled chassis, not legs; a clamp instead of a plate; asymmetric colour

briefs.label: Layered blast sounds
briefs.rule: Recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy.
briefs.why: Two sizes of blast from one family keep the sound set small and clear.
briefs.keep: Small and large impact share a sound family; the large one has more low end
briefs.change: Record or synthesise our own sounds; add a metallic ring tail; different length
